description: Expected agent access settings per governance zone

Zone1.description: Personal Productivity - Permissive access for individual development

Zone2.description: Team Collaboration - Moderate restrictions for shared workloads

Zone3.description: Enterprise Managed - Restricted access for production/customer-facing

regulatory_context.Critical: FINRA 4511 - Unapproved tool distribution to customer-facing users. Immediate remediation required.
regulatory_context.High: SOX 404 - Insufficient access controls for regulated workloads. Review within 24 hours.
regulatory_context.Warning: Governance gap - Environment not assigned to zone or minor deviation. Review within 7 days.
regulatory_context.Info: Informational - Zone 1 allows permissive settings by design. No action required.

bot-limitSharingMode.noLimit: Agents can be shared with anyone in the organization
bot-limitSharingMode.ExcludeSharingToSecurityGroups: Agent sharing restricted to security groups only

bot-authoringSharingDisabled.true: Agent authoring sharing is disabled (ALM-only deployment)
bot-authoringSharingDisabled.false: Agent authoring can be shared with editors

bot-publishedBotLimitSharingMode.noLimit: Published agents can be accessed by anyone
bot-publishedBotLimitSharingMode.ExcludeSharingToSecurityGroups: Published agent access restricted to security groups
